scripts.build: tsx scripts/validate-content.ts && tsx scripts/validate-design.ts && tsx scripts/generate-static.ts && vite build
scripts.check:all: pnpm check && pnpm folio:check && pnpm catalog:check
scripts.d1:migrations:local: pnpm dlx wrangler@4 d1 migrations apply benitoanagua-portfolio --local
scripts.d1:migrations:list: pnpm dlx wrangler@4 d1 migrations list benitoanagua-portfolio --remote
scripts.d1:migrations:remote: pnpm dlx wrangler@4 d1 migrations apply benitoanagua-portfolio --remote
scripts.cf:pages:list: pnpm dlx wrangler@4 pages project list
scripts.cf:deploy:preview: pnpm build && pnpm dlx wrangler@4 pages deploy .svelte-kit/cloudflare --project-name=benitoanagua --branch=preview
scripts.cf:deploy:production: pnpm build && pnpm dlx wrangler@4 pages deploy .svelte-kit/cloudflare --project-name=benitoanagua --branch=main
scripts.catalog:deploy: pnpm catalog:build && pnpm dlx wrangler@4 pages deploy apps/catalog/dist --config apps/catalog/wrangler.toml --project-name=benitoanagua-design-system --branch=main
scripts.catalog:pages:create: pnpm dlx wrangler@4 pages project create benitoanagua-design-system --production-branch main
scripts.build:all: pnpm build && pnpm folio:build && pnpm catalog:build
